mapper.update: UPDATE RPT_SCREEN SET canvas_style_json = #{styleJson}, canvas_draft_json = #{draftJson}, canvas_version = canvas_version + 1, publish_status = CASE WHEN publish_status = 1 THEN 2 ELSE publish_status END, updated_by = #{empId}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND canvas_version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE RPT_SCREEN SET canvas_published_json = #{publishedJson}, publish_status = #{publishStatus}, canvas_version = canvas_version + 1, published_at = NOW(), published_by = #{empId}, updated_by = #{empId}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND canvas_version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE RPT_SCREEN SET canvas_version = canvas_version + 1, updated_by = #{empId}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND canvas_version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE RPT_SCREEN SET screen_code = #{screen.screenCode}, screen_name = #{screen.screenName}, view_level = #{screen.viewLevel}, biz_line = #{screen.bizLine}, org_scope_mode = #{screen.orgScopeMode}, org_group_code = #{screen.orgGroupCode}, theme_json = #{screen.themeJson}, status = #{screen.status}, canvas_version = canvas_version + 1, updated_by = #{empId}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{screen.id} AND canvas_version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE RPT_SCREEN SET canvas_draft_json = #{draftJson}, publish_status = 1, canvas_version = canvas_version + 1, updated_by = #{empId}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND canvas_version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0
